policy_change: User requested ignoring average waiting-count growth and first scanning the boundary/maximum observed throughput.

search_reference.scope: Historical reinterpretation only. The scan does not import this lower bracket after musa-97-1 recovery changed its PID. Original data remain unchanged; a configured search_reference in future runs still requires exact comparability.

scan.interpretation: Highest passing measured point and peak measured Goodput are short-duration observations, not validated long-term system capacity or an absolute hardware maximum.

healthy_scope.scope_changed: Do not combine with previous 29-worker capacity data.

scan.scan_order: Descending, as requested; complete drain between points. Highest configured point is 64 req/s, not an established absolute maximum.

superseded_run.reason: User changed scan order after preflight; STOP issued at initial 24 req/s stage. Any partial stage is excluded from the descending run.

covered: Queue observation mode cannot bypass success/SLO/resource/offered-load gates
Reference stage is reinterpreted without changing source artifacts
Reference workload/SLO or process-identity mismatch is rejected

descending_sweep_regression.scope: system_benchmark suite; ascending and descending execution order, first failure in scan order, lowest failing rate and peak Goodput are distinct.

reproduction: Existing system_benchmark.json and benchmark.py --system-config entry; per-run source, workload, preflight and process snapshots preserve the exact decision policy and healthy worker set.
maintenance: Existing code, runtime, containers, services and metrics reused. No extra monitoring automation. Stabilized the real HAProxy burst test by reusing its thread-safe HTTPX client rather than repeatedly constructing clients inside the one-second queue deadline. Temporary test servers/processes are cleaned up by their fixtures.

preflight_incident.action: Restart briefly restored correct answers, but a single 256/1024 long-output request reproduced corruption. Stopped and quarantined only musa-97-1 in its original container; did not modify other model settings.
preflight_incident.root_cause: Undetermined. Reproduction establishes recurrence after long output on this worker; it does not establish a hardware fault.

recovery_probe.other_workers_check: Each worker produced 1024 output tokens and answered 2+3 correctly before and after.

gateway_scrape_incident.stage: 64 req/s transition; no complete measured stage
gateway_scrape_incident.failure: Gateway inflight telemetry is unavailable; no valid capacity claim
gateway_scrape_incident.evidence: HAProxy control /metrics had zero queue/connect delay; response rose from 4ms to 2022ms, next scrape client disconnected at 3002ms. Collector recorded TimeoutError. Gateway soft FD limit remained 65536 and 28 workers remained healthy.
gateway_scrape_incident.interpretation: Gateway control response exceeded the old three-second scrape deadline under overload. This does not establish the deeper latency cause or a measured capacity boundary.
gateway_scrape_incident.change: Read Gateway metrics on the existing loopback application port using canonical gateway_config; configurable ten-second timeout and matching future wait budget. Scrape failures still stop the benchmark; never zero-fill. Business SLO, admission limits and client timeout remain unchanged.
gateway_scrape_incident.validation: 58 system-benchmark/serving regression tests passed, including retained real HAProxy and official Router CPU fixtures. Confirmed telemetry configuration changes no service fingerprint. Renewed real descending scan required for overload acceptance.

startup_acceptance.scope: One full high-load stage completed and the next lower stage started automatically. This does not validate the remaining scan or long-term capacity.

completed_sweep.interpretation: All four measured points failed the success/SLO gates even with average queue growth observation-only. Highest observed Goodput is not theoretical capacity. Need new lower-rate measurements under the same 28-worker deployment to locate a passing point.

offline_copy.retained: All final server artifacts, source.zip at the measured code version, local checksum manifest and offline analysis guide. Raw artifacts remain outside Git.

comparison_to_20261027T105055Z.interpretation: 18 req/s passes this short measurement while 24 req/s failed the preceding scan. No finer point or long-duration stable capacity is established.

completed_18rps_test.limitation: MUSA waiting queues grew substantially at both nodes. Queue stability was observation-only by user instruction. A five-minute complete-cohort success/SLO pass is not a stationary-queue or long-term capacity claim.
